Test whether social interactions (proximity, affiliative and agonistic interactions) and acoustic convergence (energy distance between the calls of two birds) influence each other over time - Changes from `stats_v05_energy.qmd`, aimed at correctness and statistical power: 1. **Block alignment**: social block *k* was recorded during acoustic block *k + 1* in every group, so social data are now matched to the acoustic block recorded at the same time (previous versions matched equal block numbers, pairing acoustic data with social data from one block later) 2. **Acoustic block 1 as baseline**: recorded before the first social observation, it now provides the starting acoustic similarity for the first social period 3. **Likelihoods matching the data**: proximity modeled as the number of scans in which the two birds were < 10 cm apart out of the valid scans (beta-binomial), and interaction counts as negative binomial, instead of z-scored Gaussian responses 4. **Measurement error in acoustic distance**: bootstrap standard errors of each energy distance enter the models when acoustic dissimilarity is the response (`se()`), so dyads with few calls weigh less. When it is a (lagged) predictor its error is not modeled: `me()` slowed sampling about 25-fold, and ignoring predictor error can only attenuate its slope toward zero, so those estimates are conservative 5. **Joint cross-lagged model**: acoustic and social responses modeled together, each on the previous block's values of the others 6. **Inference based on effect posteriors** (pd, 95% CI); LOO comparisons are reported per response as a secondary check 7. **Treatment (Young / Old)** included as a covariate in all models ::: # Load packages {.unnumbered .unlisted} ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # sketchy is used to install/load the packages below if (!requireNamespace("sketchy", quietly = TRUE)) { install.packages("sketchy") } packages <- c("ggplot2", "viridis", "pbapply", "brms", "ggcorrplot", "brmsish", "proxy", "posterior", "bayestestR", "extraDistr" # needed by brms for beta-binomial log-likelihoods (LOO) ) # install/ load packages sketchy::load_packages(packages = packages) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Warning: replacing previous import 'brms::rstudent_t' by 'ggdist::rstudent_t' when loading 'brmsish' ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Warning: replacing previous import 'brms::dstudent_t' by 'ggdist::dstudent_t' when loading 'brmsish' ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Warning: replacing previous import 'brms::qstudent_t' by 'ggdist::qstudent_t' when loading 'brmsish' ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Warning: replacing previous import 'brms::pstudent_t' by 'ggdist::pstudent_t' when loading 'brmsish' ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Loading required package: ggplot2 ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Loading required package: viridis ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Loading required package: viridisLite ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Loading required package: pbapply ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Loading required package: brms ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Loading required package: Rcpp ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Loading 'brms' package (version 2.23.0). Acoustic distances with measurement error - Use the PCA on MFCC descriptors from `choosing_vocal_convergence_metric.qmd` (PCs explaining 90% of variance), keeping individual/blocks with at least 10 calls. Unlike previous versions, **acoustic block 1 is kept** as the baseline, and the minimum is lowered from 25 to **10 calls**: the bootstrap SE below down-weights imprecise distances, so birds with 10 to 24 calls can contribute instead of being discarded (below 10 calls the energy distance itself becomes unreliable) - For each pair of birds from the same group recorded in the same block, compute the **energy distance** $2E\|X - Y\| - E\|X - X'\| - E\|Y - Y'\|$ from call-to-call Euclidean distances in PC space: the mean distance between the calls of the two birds minus each bird's own within-bird call variability (within-bird terms exclude self-pairs, U-statistic). It is 0 only when both birds' call distributions are identical - Its precision depends on how many calls each bird has (10 to > 1,000), so a **bootstrap standard error** is estimated by resampling each bird's calls (100 replicates) ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} dist_file <- "./data/processed/energy_distances_bootstrap_min10calls.RDS" if (!file.exists(dist_file)) { set.seed(123) n_boot <- 100 pca_dat <- readRDS("./data/processed/pca_dat.RDS") pcs <- grep("^PC", names(pca_dat), value = TRUE) pca_dat$id_block <- paste(pca_dat$ID, pca_dat$record.block, sep = "_") # keep individual/blocks with at least 10 calls (all blocks, # including block 1) call_counts <- table(pca_dat$id_block) pca_dat <- pca_dat[pca_dat$id_block %in% names(call_counts)[call_counts >= 10], ] # energy distance from a call-to-call distance matrix, given # the row indices of each bird (within-bird terms exclude # self-pairs: U-statistic) energy_from_D <- function(D, ia, ib) { 2 * mean(D[ia, ib]) - sum(D[ia, ia])/(length(ia) * (length(ia) - 1)) - sum(D[ib, ib])/(length(ib) * (length(ib) - 1)) } grp_blk <- unique(pca_dat[, c("record.group", "record.block")]) out <- pblapply(seq_len(nrow(grp_blk)), function(i) { Y <- pca_dat[pca_dat$record.group == grp_blk$record.group[i] & pca_dat$record.block == grp_blk$record.block[i], ] ids <- sort(unique(Y$ID)) if (length(ids) < 2) return(NULL) # all call-to-call distances in this group/block D <- as.matrix(dist(as.matrix(Y[, pcs]))) rows <- lapply(ids, function(id) which(Y$ID == id)) names(rows) <- ids pairs <- t(combn(ids, 2)) do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(pairs)), function(j) { ia <- rows[[pairs[j, 1]]] ib <- rows[[pairs[j, 2]]] boot <- replicate(n_boot, energy_from_D(D, sample(ia, replace = TRUE), sample(ib, replace = TRUE))) data.frame(indiv.1 = pairs[j, 1], indiv.2 = pairs[j, 2], time = grp_blk$record.block[i], n.calls.1 = length(ia), n.calls.2 = length(ib), energy = energy_from_D(D, ia, ib), energy_se = sd(boot)) })) }) energy_dists <- do.call(rbind, out) rownames(energy_dists) <- NULL saveRDS(energy_dists, dist_file) } energy_dists <- readRDS(dist_file) # dyads per acoustic block table(time = energy_dists$time) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` time 1 2 3 4 5 66 57 54 50 47 ``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} energy_dists$min_calls <- pmin(energy_dists$n.calls.1, energy_dists$n.calls.2) ggplot(energy_dists, aes(x = min_calls, y = energy_se)) + geom_point(color = mako(10)[5], alpha = 0.7) + scale_x_log10() + labs(x = "Calls of the bird with fewer calls (log scale)", y = "Bootstrap SE of energy distance") + theme_classic() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](stats_v06_energy_files/figure-html/plot energy distance precision-1.png){width=576} ::: ::: ## Social data aligned to acoustic blocks - Social blocks were recorded during the following acoustic block in all 12 groups (midpoint dates within 0.1 to 2.4 days): **social block *k* corresponds to acoustic block *k + 1***. A common time index `time` (= acoustic block, 1 to 5) is used, with social data available for times 2 to 5 - The block alignment is checked below from the recording dates of the proximity videos and the acoustic recordings. The affiliative and agonistic edge lists have no dates and are assumed to follow the same block numbering as the proximity data - Proximity: number of scans in which the two birds were < 10 cm apart (`n_close`) out of the scans in which both birds were visible (`n_valid`) - Affiliative and agonistic interactions: number of interactions in either direction per dyad and block (0 when the dyad does not appear in that block's edge list) ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} invisible(Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", "C")) prox_raw <- read.csv("./data/raw/Proximity_Raw_Data_R.csv") prox_raw$date <- as.Date(prox_raw$Video_date, "%d-%b-%y") sel_meta <- read.csv("./data/raw/sp_selections_analysis_metadata.csv") sel_meta$date <- as.Date(sel_meta$date.format) alignment <- do.call(rbind, lapply(sort(unique(prox_raw$Group)), function(g) { soc_mid <- tapply(prox_raw$date[prox_raw$Group == g], prox_raw$block[prox_raw$Group == g], mean) ac_mid <- tapply(sel_meta$date[sel_meta$record.group == g], sel_meta$record.block[sel_meta$record.group == g], mean) data.frame(group = g, social_block = as.numeric(names(soc_mid)), acoustic_block_same_dates = as.numeric(sapply(soc_mid, function(s) names(ac_mid)[which.min(abs(ac_mid - s))])), days_apart = sapply(soc_mid, function(s) round(min(abs(ac_mid - s)), 1))) })) table(social_block = alignment$social_block, acoustic_block = alignment$acoustic_block_same_dates) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` acoustic_block social_block 2 3 4 5 1 12 0 0 0 2 0 12 0 0 3 0 0 12 0 4 0 0 0 12 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} range(alignment$days_apart) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] 0.1 2.4 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} stopifnot(all(alignment$acoustic_block_same_dates == alignment$social_block + 1)) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # proximity: close and valid scans per dyad and social block prox_raw$pair <- paste(prox_raw$Neighbor_1, prox_raw$Neighbor_2, sep = "_") prox_agg <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(prox_raw, list(prox_raw$pair, prox_raw$block), drop = TRUE), function(x) { data.frame( pair = x$pair[1], indiv.1 = x$Neighbor_1[1], indiv.2 = x$Neighbor_2[1], group = paste0("g", x$Group[1]), treatment = x$Treatment[1], time = x$block[1] + 1, # social block k = acoustic block k + 1 n_close = sum(x$Distance_cm < 10, na.rm = TRUE), n_valid = sum(!is.na(x$Distance_cm)) ) })) # affiliative and agonistic interactions per dyad and social block count_interactions <- function(prefix) { files <- list.files("./data/raw", pattern = paste0("^", prefix, "_g.*_block[0-9]\\.csv$"), full.names = TRUE) do.call(rbind, lapply(files, function(x) { Y <- read.csv(x, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) if (nrow(Y) == 0) return(NULL) names(Y)[1:2] <- c("actor", "recipient") block <- as.numeric(gsub("block|\\.csv", "", strsplit(basename(x), "_")[[1]][4])) pairs <- apply(Y[, c("actor", "recipient")], 1, function(z) paste(sort(z), collapse = "_")) tab <- table(pairs) data.frame(pair = names(tab), time = block + 1, n = as.vector(tab)) })) } aff_counts <- count_interactions("aff") ago_counts <- count_interactions("ago") social <- prox_agg social$affiliative <- 0 social$agonistic <- 0 key_soc <- paste(social$pair, social$time) social$affiliative[match(paste(aff_counts$pair, aff_counts$time), key_soc)] <- aff_counts$n social$agonistic[match(paste(ago_counts$pair, ago_counts$time), key_soc)] <- ago_counts$n # check that all interaction records matched a dyad in the proximity data stopifnot(all(paste(aff_counts$pair, aff_counts$time) %in% key_soc), all(paste(ago_counts$pair, ago_counts$time) %in% key_soc)) head(social) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display}

Predictors are standardized: acoustic dissimilarity (energy distance) and its SE are divided by the SD of energy distance, proximity enters as the proportion of close scans and interaction counts as log(count + 1), each z-scored - Lagged (previous block) and lead (next block) values are computed within dyad, only when the adjacent block exists ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} dyads <- unique(social[, c("pair", "indiv.1", "indiv.2", "group", "treatment")]) dat <- merge(dyads, data.frame(time = 1:5)) dat <- merge(dat, social[, c("pair", "time", "n_close", "n_valid", "affiliative", "agonistic")], by = c("pair", "time"), all.x = TRUE) energy_dists$pair <- paste(energy_dists$indiv.1, energy_dists$indiv.2, sep = "_") dat <- merge(dat, energy_dists[, c("pair", "time", "energy", "energy_se")], by = c("pair", "time"), all.x = TRUE) dat <- dat[order(dat$pair, dat$time), ] # standardize (names without underscores keep brms parameter # names simple) ac_mean <- mean(dat$energy, na.rm = TRUE) ac_sd <- sd(dat$energy, na.rm = TRUE) dat$ac <- (dat$energy - ac_mean)/ac_sd dat$acse <- dat$energy_se/ac_sd z <- function(x) as.vector(scale(x)) dat$prox <- z(dat$n_close/dat$n_valid) dat$ago <- z(log1p(dat$agonistic)) dat$aff <- z(log1p(dat$affiliative)) dat$treatment <- factor(dat$treatment, levels = c("Old", "Young")) # previous and next block values within dyad shift_by_time <- function(d, vars, k) { for (v in vars) { d[[paste0(v, ifelse(k > 0, "lag", "lead"))]] <- d[[v]][match(d$time - k, d$time)] } d } lag_vars <- c("ac", "acse", "prox", "ago", "aff") dat <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(dat, dat$pair), function(d) { d <- shift_by_time(d, lag_vars, 1) shift_by_time(d, c("prox", "ago", "aff"), -1) })) rownames(dat) <- NULL write.csv(dat, "./data/processed/dyad_by_time_energy_aligned.csv", row.names = FALSE) # rows usable by each model n_models <- data.frame(model = c("Model 1: social during period -> acoustic change", "Model 2: cross-lagged, acoustic response", "Model 2: cross-lagged, social responses", "Placebo: next period social -> acoustic change", "stats_v05 lagged models (misaligned blocks)"), rows = c(sum(complete.cases(dat[, c("ac", "aclag", "prox", "ago", "aff")])), sum(complete.cases(dat[, c("ac", "aclag", "proxlag", "agolag", "afflag")])), sum(complete.cases(dat[, c("aclag", "prox", "proxlag", "ago", "agolag", "aff", "afflag")])), sum(complete.cases(dat[, c("ac", "aclag", "proxlead", "agolead", "afflead")])), 77)) n_models ``` ::: {.cell-output-display}

LOO comparisons treat |elpd_diff| < 4 or |elpd_diff| / SE < 2 as indistinguishable ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code code-fold="true"} iterations <- 4000 warmup <- 2000 # convergence diagnostics on population-level and variance # parameters fit_diag <- function(fit) { np <- nuts_params(fit) drws <- posterior::subset_draws(posterior::as_draws_df(fit), variable = "^(b_|sd_|sigma|shape|phi)", regex = TRUE) smry <- posterior::summarise_draws(drws, "rhat", "ess_bulk", "ess_tail") list(ndiv = sum(np$Value[np$Parameter == "divergent__"]), ndraws = posterior::ndraws(fit), rhat = max(smry$rhat, na.rm = TRUE), ess_bulk = min(smry$ess_bulk, na.rm = TRUE), ess_tail = min(smry$ess_tail, na.rm = TRUE), n = nrow(fit$data)) } diag_text <- function(d) { ok_mix <- d$rhat <= 1.01 && min(d$ess_bulk, d$ess_tail) >= 400 verdict <- if (d$ndiv == 0 && ok_mix) { "the chains converged to a common posterior and the reported medians and CIs are not limited by sampling noise" } else if (ok_mix && d$ndiv/d$ndraws < 0.005) { "the few divergences (< 0.5% of draws) are unlikely to bias the estimates, although raising `adapt_delta` further would be needed to remove them entirely" } else { "the estimates should be treated with caution until the sampler problems are resolved" } paste0("Across 4 chains x ", iterations, " iterations (", warmup, " warmup; n = ", d$n, " rows) there were ", d$ndiv, " divergent transitions, the largest R-hat is ", sprintf("%.3f", d$rhat), " and the minimum bulk and tail ESS are ", round(d$ess_bulk), " and ", round(d$ess_tail), " (rule of thumb: R-hat <= 1.01 and ESS >= ~400), so ", verdict, ".") } # name of the single parameter matching a pattern (e.g. # coefficients of multivariate responses) find_par <- function(fit, pattern) { nm <- grep(pattern, posterior::variables(fit), value = TRUE) if (length(nm) != 1) stop("pattern '", pattern, "' matched: ", paste(nm, collapse = ", ")) nm } # posterior summary of a single coefficient coef_stats <- function(fit, pattern) { x <- posterior::as_draws_df(fit)[[find_par(fit, pattern)]] list(est = median(x), lo = unname(quantile(x, 0.025)), hi = unname(quantile(x, 0.975)), pd = max(mean(x > 0), mean(x < 0))) } fmt_coef <- function(cs) { sprintf("median = %.2f, 95%% CI [%.2f, %.2f], pd = %.3f", cs$est, cs$lo, cs$hi, cs$pd) } support <- function(cs) { if (cs$lo > 0 || cs$hi < 0) "credible" else if (cs$pd >= 0.95) "suggestive" else "not supported" } # sentence describing an effect; 'pos' / 'neg' describe what a # positive / negative slope means claim <- function(cs, pos, neg) { dir_text <- if (cs$est > 0) pos else neg switch(support(cs), credible = paste0("**Credible**: ", dir_text, " (", fmt_coef(cs), ")."), suggestive = paste0("**Suggestive only** (pd >= 0.95 but the 95% CI includes zero): ", dir_text, " (", fmt_coef(cs), ")."), paste0("**Not supported**: the 95% CI includes zero and pd < 0.95 (", fmt_coef(cs), "), so the data are consistent with no effect.")) } # LOO comparison of full vs null model loo_stats <- function(loo_full, loo_null) { cmp <- loo_compare(loo_null, loo_full) d <- loo_full$estimates["elpd_loo", "Estimate"] - loo_null$estimates["elpd_loo", "Estimate"] se <- as.numeric(cmp[2, "se_diff"]) list(diff = d, se = se, ratio = abs(d)/se, nk = sum(loo_full$diagnostics$pareto_k > 0.7), verdict = if (abs(d) < 4 || abs(d)/se < 2) "indistinguishable" else if (d > 0) "better" else "worse") } loo_text <- function(l, what) { paste0("Adding ", what, " changes expected out-of-sample predictive accuracy by elpd = ", sprintf("%.2f", l$diff), " (SE = ", sprintf("%.2f", l$se), "; |diff| / SE = ", sprintf("%.2f", l$ratio), "), so the full model is ", switch(l$verdict, indistinguishable = "**not distinguishable from the null** in predictive terms", better = "**credibly better than the null** in predictive terms", worse = "**credibly worse than the null** in predictive terms"), if (l$nk > 0) paste0(" (", l$nk, " observations with Pareto k > 0.7, so this PSIS-LOO estimate is approximate)") else "", ".") } any_credible <- function(...) any(sapply(list(...), support) == "credible") ``` ::: ## Model 1: social behavior during a period and acoustic convergence - Response: acoustic dissimilarity (energy distance, standardized) at time *t*, with its bootstrap SE (`se()`), so imprecise distances weigh less - Predictors: acoustic dissimilarity at *t - 1*, proximity, agonistic and affiliative interactions recorded **during** time *t*, and treatment. Because the previous acoustic dissimilarity is controlled, the social coefficients describe the **change** in acoustic similarity over a period in which the dyad interacted more or less: a negative slope means more interaction goes with more convergence - Uses acoustic block 1 as the baseline for the first social period - Compared against a null without the social predictors ```{.r .cell-code} dat_m1 <- dat[complete.cases(dat[, c("ac", "acse", "aclag", "acselag", "prox", "ago", "aff")]), ] priors_m1 <- c(prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept"), prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b"), prior(exponential(2), class = "sd"), prior(exponential(1), class = "sigma")) mod_m1 <- brm(ac | se(acse, sigma = TRUE) ~ aclag + prox + ago + aff + treatment + (1 | group) + (1 | mm(indiv.1, indiv.2)), data = dat_m1, family = gaussian(), save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE), prior = priors_m1, chains = 4, cores = 4, iter = iterations, warmup = warmup, backend = "cmdstanr", threads = threading(8), control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15), file = "./data/processed/fits/brms_v06_m1_energy", file_refit = "on_change") mod_m1_null <- brm(ac | se(acse, sigma = TRUE) ~ aclag + treatment + (1 | group) + (1 | mm(indiv.1, indiv.2)), data = dat_m1, family = gaussian(), save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE), prior = priors_m1, chains = 4, cores = 4, iter = iterations, warmup = warmup, backend = "cmdstanr", threads = threading(8), control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15), file = "./data/processed/fits/brms_v06_m1_null_energy", file_refit = "on_change") extended_summary(mod_m1) ``` ``` Loading required namespace: rstan ``` ## mod_m1
